Nourhan, My Home
Two letters, a few reasons, and a promise

Nourhan

my wife, my girl, my everything

Enta Omri, Umm Kulthum · "you are my life"
First letter

Nourhan, my mommy, my wife, my girl, my everything. I really, really love you, more than anything in this world, and no words could ever hold how much.

You matter to me more than anything. I care for you, I'm proud of you, and I'll be beside you on the hard days and on the good ones. Whenever things get heavy, you can run to me. I'll be there every single time, and I'll be your biggest supporter.

I'll always try to fix everything, and when I can't, I promise I'll stand in it with you. I'll keep trying to make you happy and keep taking care of you. There's a place in my heart that nobody ever came close to. It's yours only, and it always will be.

I'll be your man, your little boy, your baby, your home. I choose you, and I want to spend every minute of my life with you until the day I die. Even then I'll keep loving you and keep an eye on you, because you're my only love.

I can never describe it, but I want you to know one thing. I will always choose you, always love you, and always be by your side. For eternity.

forever yours
Roses for my rose

Red, like how I feel

Second letter

Nourhan, my baby, I love you past anything words can say.

You're the sweetest thing that ever happened to me, the most amazing and most adorable person I've ever seen. I'm so lucky to have you in my life, and so lucky that you love me and care for me. You're my wife, my girl, my best friend, my sister, every good thing I have, and the reason I wake up each day and keep going.

You're the prettiest girl I've ever seen. And your eyes. I fall in love with them every single time, like it's the very first time. They're perfect. And don't even let me start on your face.

I love you so much, my wife, my girl, my baby. I'll always choose you and I'll love you till eternity. I hope I stay with you all my life, and I'll make up for everything that ever hurt you, every little thing.

forever yours
